messages:
Carlos (AE): hey team — AcmeCorp asked for a quick POC to replace their current vendor with our API. they want minimal code changes, so they asked if we can provide a 'stitch' compatibility layer that accepts their existing calls
Lily (Sales Eng): cool. main asks from presales: 1) mapping parity for their prompt templates 2) response delta expectations and mitigation 3) pricing impact if we have to run dual calls during rollout
Jonas (Solutions Eng): for the stitch layer we can support the top-level mapping (endpoint names + headers) and a lightweight adapter for param translation. need to confirm their request/response schema. can we get an example payload?
Carlos (AE): pasted sample from their devs: 
```json
{
  "session_id": "abc123",
  "input": "Summarize the following...",
  "model": "vendor-neo-v2",
  "max_len": 512,
  "stream": false
}
```
Jonas (Solutions Eng): ok. translation table looks straightforward. two technical risks: 1) behavior deltas due to different tokenization / stop sequences 2) streaming vs non-streaming semantics differences (we stream by default on hosted)
Lily (Sales Eng): they specifically called out "prompt parity" — want sample-to-sample equivalence for 90% of cases. do we have a reasonable expectation?
Jonas (Solutions Eng): short answer: can get close but not exact. strategies: prompt normalization layer (escape sequences, dedupe system messages), reranking layer to prefer matching responses, and a small prompt tuning shim. we'll propose an eval harness — 500 golden prompts from Acme to measure delta.
Priya (Security): from security checklist: they need KMS BYOK, network allowlist, audit logs, and SOC2 attestation. Private deployment or Dedicated will cover most asks. for POC we can offer a staging Dedicated with short-lived certs.
Aaron (Legal): also need IP/Data residency language for POC. they requested a 30-day data purge for POC logs. acceptable?
Carlos (AE): yes, Acme wants that. also pricing Q: if they run both endpoints for parity compare, how do we bill? they want clarity on token billing while dual-running.
Lily (Sales Eng): recommend we offer temporary dual-run credits: first 100k tokens free for migration period (30 days), then standard per-token thereafter. flag to finance if needed.
Jonas (Solutions Eng): technical checklist for POC (high level):
- adapter that accepts vendor payloads -> maps to Redwood API
- prompt normalization rules (we'll share a repo)
- evaluation harness (side-by-side diffs + BLEU-ish + semantic sim scores)
- fallback routing: if model mismatch, return vendor behavior or best-effort note
- metrics collection (latency, token delta, similarity)

Quick config example for translation proxy (we can give them):
```yaml
# stitch-proxy mapping example
routes:
  - from: /v1/generate
    to: /v1/completions
    map:
      body.input: body.prompt
      body.max_len: body.max_tokens
      headers.x-client: headers.x-source
```
Jonas (Solutions Eng): expected dev effort: 2 engineers ~2 weeks to produce POC adapter + harness. can shrink if Acme only sends a limited prompt subset.
Priya (Security): POC blockers: BYOK integration timeline (depends on customer KMS), network peering window, and contractual NDA for access to sample prompts. if they insist on air-gapped data we need Private deployment which is longer lead time.
Carlos (AE): action items for this thread: 1) request sample prompt set + sample responses from Acme 2) propose dual-run credit proposal 3) draft quick security checklist response 4) timeline estimate to Acme
Lily (Sales Eng): I'll draft the technical scope note and the eval plan. Jonas, can you attach the normalization rules repo link when ready?
Jonas (Solutions Eng): yes. pushing initial adapter prototype branch later today, will put draft rules in README. sample curl we can give them for smoke test:
```bash
curl -X POST https://redwood.example/stitch/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"session_id":"abc123","input":"Tell me a joke","model":"vendor-neo-v2"}'
```
Aaron (Legal): I'll review the 30-day purge language and return a one-off addendum for the POC. also will need to confirm whether logs are considered "aggregate" for the purge (we usually allow aggregated metrics to be retained).
Priya (Security): I'll prepare a short security FAQ for the POC: BYOK steps, temporary allowlist IPs, and expected cert rotations.
Carlos (AE): timeline to customer: propose 2-week POC, deliverables: adapter repo, eval report, security checklist. send draft by EOD tomorrow.
Lily (Sales Eng): noted. any blockers from finance for the token credit? finance tag? :finance:
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging-dedicated-01 will be available for provisioning at 2024-03-05T09:00Z
Carlos (AE): perfect. thanks everyone — I'll confirm sample prompt transfer and loop Acme Dev with Lily + Jonas + Priya
Lily (Sales Eng): thanks — will include instructions for the smoke curl and a short runbook for their engineers. :thumbsup:
Jonas (Solutions Eng): will also include a small test-suite so they can run local diffs. will ping when branch is ready.
Aaron (Legal): tagging end: I need the exact data flow diagram before I sign off on the purge clause. can someone drop that here?
Jonas (Solutions Eng): will sketch and attach in thread tomorrow morning.
Carlos (AE): closing notes: we should avoid promising 100% parity. commit to 90%+ similarity target for initial rollout and iterate with eval. I'll capture that in the customer note.
